The structure of Pd₂Mo₂B₈ (PdMoB₄) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with 9 neighbors (1 B, 2 Mo, 6 Pd) and 11 neighbors (2 B, 1 Mo, 8 Pd), while Mo and Pd each adopt 10-neighbor environments with B and mixed B/Mo/Pd coordination. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between 11-vertex B polyhedra and both Mo- and Pd-centered 10-vertex polyhedra, with edge-sharing also observed among B-centered polyhedra.
